init_sim_wrapper: create a SimplePybulletWrapperPositionControl instance with a URDF path and list of controlled joints
reset_joint_state: reset all robot joint positions to specified values using the reset_joint_state method
get_link_state: get the position and orientation of a robot link by its ID using get_link_state
step_simulation: step the simulation forward with desired joint positions using position control mode
run_robot_sim: run a PyBullet robot simulation with position control and forward kinematics queries
